name: Sanctuary Audit Overview
description: Decision and result overview for XDM-shaped Sanctuary audit exports. Repo-verified only; no live tenant drill.

widgets.title: Denied operations
widgets.query: dataset = sanctuary_audit_raw | filter sanctuary.audit.decision = "deny" | comp count() as denies

widgets.title: Operations by outcome
widgets.query: dataset = sanctuary_audit_raw | comp count() by xdm.event.operation, xdm.event.outcome
